entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: Phase 6 verification evidence is older than the current build claims and manifest, so the passed verification cannot prove the May 17 Phase 6 changes.
entries.suggestion: Rerun aether continue/full verification after the May 17 build and ensure the new verification artifacts have fresh timestamps and cover current claims.

entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: The phase contract requires full verification without skipped watchers, but the verification report records the watcher as skipped via skip-watchers.
entries.suggestion: Rerun continue without --skip-watchers and require watcher/review artifacts to complete before advancement.

entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: The phase asks to persist concrete release verification evidence, but no porter readiness receipt was found under .aether/data/porter/readiness.json; only code/tests proving the ability to write one were present.
entries.suggestion: Run porter check --full-release or otherwise persist the release readiness receipt before sealing.

entries.description: Phase 6 source fixes appear substantive, but the canonical verification artifact still has watcher.passed=false, checks_passed=false, passed=false, and a blocking issue saying the evidence cannot justify advancement.
entries.suggestion: Regenerate the continue/finalizer verification evidence after the r2 fixes so the canonical phase artifact reflects Guard-98-r2 rather than Hawk-41.

entries.description: review.json still has passed=false and blocking_issues for stale evidence and the old porter redaction blocker, despite newer manifest r2 worker summaries.
entries.suggestion: Regenerate review.json or rerun the final continue review path after the fixed redaction and readiness receipt are in place.

entries.description: Post-commit full-release Porter receipt generated at 2026-05-17T12:52:46Z reports overall ok, full-release scope, no failed checks, clean git status, and release/tool verification checks passed. Earlier blocked verification/review artifacts are stale relative to commit c69c2faa and this receipt.
entries.suggestion: Advance using the fresh post-commit Porter receipt as current release-readiness evidence; regenerate canonical continue artifacts during advancement if the runtime needs them normalized.

entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: Current colony state is COMPLETED at current_phase 6, and commit c69c2faa is HEAD; only .aether/CONTEXT.md is modified after continue bookkeeping. This supports seal from a state and traceability standpoint.
entries.suggestion: Proceed with seal if final-review workers return no blockers; keep runtime bookkeeping out of source-release gating.

entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: gates.json has passed=true and all gate checks passed, but still carries a stale blocking_issues entry about missing implementation evidence. Current verification, continue review, and Porter receipt supersede it, so this is not a seal blocker, but the artifact is contradictory.
entries.suggestion: Clear or regenerate blocking_issues when gates pass so final reviewers do not have to reconcile stale blocker text.

entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: Phase 6 is completed but has empty tasks and no explicit success_criteria in COLONY_STATE. The release evidence exists in manifest dispatches and readiness receipts, but future cleanup phases should encode task criteria in state.
entries.suggestion: When inserting cleanup phases, persist concrete tasks and success criteria before build dispatch.

entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: Passed gate artifact still carries stale blocking_issues text.
entries.suggestion: Regenerate stale blocker fields when evidence is superseded.
